title: Greed
overview: Some people are never happy, regardless of money and love. Eb wants to bribe politicians to win his election. Tabitha, a spoiled, bratty teenager, is constantly bugging her father for a new car at ANY cost, which results in dire consequences for the young girl. Leo is a professional working man who gets into a relationship with a selfish woman. Greed is a movie which gets into many characters' lives, the ones mentioned above and more, and shows how greed can ruin a person, no matter how old.
